entries.def:
§ Hazar-susah = "horse village"
one of the cities allotted to Simeon in the extreme south of Judah and the place where Solomon kept horses

§ Hazar-susim = "village of horses"
a place in Simeon

Hazar-enon = "village of springs"
a city on the northeast border of Canaan; same as cha.tsar e.nan (חֲצַר עֵינוֹן "Hazar-enan" H2704)
Another spelling of cha.tsar e.nan (חֲצַר עֵינוֹן "Hazar-enan" H2704)

Hazar-enan = "village of fountains"
a city on the northeast border of Canaan; same as cha.tsar e.non (חֲצַר עֵינָן "Hazar-enan" H2703)
Also named: cha.tsar e.non (חֲצַר עֵינָן "Hazar-enan" H2703)

§ Hazar-shual = "jackal village"
a town in southern Judah
